title: Day 113: Iran Announces Renewed Closure of Strait of Hormuz; MSF Calls Nabatieh a 'Death Trap' Amid Continued Lebanon Strikes
detail: Iran said it was closing the Strait of Hormuz in response to what it called renewed Israeli ceasefire violations in Lebanon. The US military denied Iran's claim of control over the strait; Trump threatened US tolls on the waterway if no deal was reached. Dozens were killed by Israeli strikes in Lebanon over the prior two days despite the stated truce — among the worst bloodshed of the conflict to that point. MSF said conditions in Nabatieh resembled a 'death trap.'

media.caption: Iran shuts Hormuz again as Vance heads to Switzerland for talks
